name: Dubey 2007
aliases: Dubey buccal mucosa versus penile skin flap
question: How do dorsal onlay buccal mucosa graft and penile skin flap urethroplasty compare for complex anterior urethral strictures?

arms.label: Dorsal onlay buccal mucosa graft urethroplasty
dorsal onlay penile skin flap urethroplasty

design.population: Fifty-five patients with inflammatory or idiopathic anterior urethral strictures requiring substitution urethroplasty were assigned by alternation to dorsal onlay repair. Mean stricture lengths were 5.6 cm (range 4–15) with buccal mucosa and 6.0 cm (4–12) with flap repair.
design.description: Prospective randomized comparison of dorsal onlay substitutions
design.locator: Full text, Materials and Methods, p 2466; Tables 1 and 4

verdictNote: No primary endpoint or statistical threshold was prespecified; reported success rates conflict with recurrence counts.
takeaway: In 55 alternation-assigned patients with inflammatory or idiopathic anterior strictures, buccal graft and penile flap repairs had 3/27 and 4/28 recurrences at median 22.6 and 24.2 months. Flap repair took longer, with more penile morbidity and less patient recommendation.

reports.label: Randomized comparison
reports.citation: Dubey D, Vijjan V, Kapoor R, et al. Dorsal onlay buccal mucosa versus penile skin flap urethroplasty for anterior urethral strictures: results from a randomized prospective trial. *J Urol.* 2007;178(6):2466-2469. doi:10.1016/j.juro.2007.08.010
reports.followUp: Median 22.6 months (buccal mucosa) and 24.2 months (penile flap); all patients followed at least 12 months

results.measure: No subsequent urethral procedure (internal urethrotomy, dilation or urethroplasty); all 55 patients followed at least 12 months
results.note: Table 4 reports 89.9% and 85.8%, while its 3/27 and 4/28 recurrence counts imply 88.9% and 85.7%. The abstract instead prints 85.6% for the flap arm. No primary endpoint or threshold is designated.
results.locator: Full text, Materials and Methods, p 2467; Results, p 2467; Table 4

results.measure: Patients with recurrence after dorsal onlay urethroplasty
results.note: All seven underwent internal urethrotomy; one buccal-mucosa patient subsequently needed penile flap urethroplasty.

results.measure: Would recommend the procedure to another patient at six months
results.note: Counts derive from 3/27 and 10/28 who would not recommend treatment; Table 4 prints 89% and 64.3%. The abstract prints 65% for the flap arm.
results.locator: Full text, Materials and Methods, p 2467; Results, p 2467; Table 4

harms.label: Troublesome postvoid dribbling
harms.note: Defined by the need for manual urethral compression after voiding; p = 0.001. The abstract prints 34.1%, whereas the full-text prose prints 32.14%.

harms.label: Superficial penile skin necrosis
harms.note: Superficial necrosis healed within six weeks. The text does not state whether the extensive skin-loss case overlaps with these six.

harms.label: Extensive penile skin loss requiring grafting
harms.note: Overlap with superficial necrosis cases is not stated.

harms.label: Penile torsion
harms.note: Slight torsion did not interfere with intercourse.

harms.label: Minor oral morbidity after buccal mucosa repair

values.bmg: 6/27 patients reported in prose; Table 3 lists 7 oral complications

harms.note: The prose prints 25.7% for six patients, but 6/27 is 22.2%; the abstract prints 25.6%. Prose lists four with numbness, two with salivation changes and one mucus cyst; Table 3 lists three with increased salivation. Symptoms settled by four weeks.

harms.label: Penile hypoesthesia
harms.note: The three cases did not interfere with erection or intercourse.

harms.label: Hematoma and minor wound infection
harms.note: Hematoma and minor wound infection were described as similar between groups.

harms.label: Three-week cystogram extravasation requiring prolonged catheterization
harms.note: Each patient required one additional week of catheterization.

delivery.label: Dorsal onlay substitution
delivery.value: Urethra mobilized from the corpora, rotated 180 degrees and opened dorsally; buccal mucosa graft or penile skin flap applied as a dorsal onlay. Buccal repair used two teams; flap repair used one. Voiding cystogram at three weeks, followed by uroflowmetry and calibration or cystoscopy at one month, every three months in year one and every six months thereafter.
delivery.locator: Full text, Materials and Methods, p 2467

delivery.label: Mean operative time
delivery.note: p = 0.001; the buccal repair used a two-team approach.

delivery.label: Graft harvest and flap design

values.bmg: single cheek 10/27; both cheeks 11/27; both cheeks plus lower lip 6/27

delivery.locator: Full text, Materials and Methods, p 2467; Table 2
delivery.note: Tissue source and flap design varied by stricture length and site.
